title: How to Utilize the Power of Rational Thinking
coreMove: Use reason to inspect the idea behind emotion, then give the automatic mechanism a truer picture backed by desire.

exampleSpecs.audience: students learning a practical mind model
exampleSpecs.stakes: A Freud comparison could turn into fatalism unless the automatic mechanism is given conscious steering.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use Freud's unconscious as a comparison while keeping conscious input in charge.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A patient may treat past errors as permanent instructions instead of changing present thinking.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Schindler-style conscious thought control beginning in the present.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A miss can guide correction or become the next target picture.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use trial and error as negative feedback for skill learning.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A useful review can become rumination if the error remains the mental target.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use negative feedback, then release the mistake from memory.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Worry can rehearse a negative goal picture minutes before performance.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show worry feeding the automatic mechanism an unwanted target.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Dry logic may not move action unless desire gives the truer idea force.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Pair rational checking with desire instead of suppressing emotion.
